[MCP]
Short for Mission Clear Points.

Earn them by completing designated MCP missions.

Collect enough to unlock Boost missions that improve
player abilities and help players make major progress!<+LR>Switch <○>Close 3/4
overrides.0x8208C170:
[Mission Period]
This is the time allowed for a mission. Meet its
requirements before the deadline.

When Mission Period is measured in games, the counter
advances whenever a game is played.

When Mission Period is measured in days, time passes
even on rainouts and travel days, so plan carefully.<+LR>Switch <○>Close 2/4
overrides.0x8208C388:
[Missions]
Complete missions to develop players and improve your
chances in Pennant mode.

Owner requests, player milestones, and other important
missions appear automatically.

[Selecting Missions]
Players can take on many kinds of missions. Meet their
requirements within the Mission Period to succeed.
Choose missions that suit your strengths to develop
efficiently. Available missions also depend on your
current abilities.<+LR>Switch <○>Close 1/4
overrides.0x8208C5E0:
[Coach Capacity]
The number of stars held by your position-player and pitching
coaches is their capacity.

It limits how many missions they can oversee. Each
active mission temporarily uses its assigned number of
stars.

The stars return when the mission ends.

Certain missions can even increase Coach Capacity!<+LR>Switch <○>Close 6/6
overrides.0x8208CA70:
[MCP]
Short for Mission Clear Points.

Any position player on the active roster can earn
points through designated MCP missions.

Collect enough to unlock an Boost mission!<+LR>Switch <○>Close 4/6
overrides.0x8208CDE8:
[Selecting Missions]
Choose missions to address your team's needs.

Take on as many as your Coach Capacity allows. Meet
their requirements within the Mission Period.

Earn rewards such as Manager Commands, Manager Charisma,
and MCP!<+LR>Switch <○>Close 2/6
overrides.0x8208CFC8:
[Missions]
Complete missions to gain an advantage in Pennant mode.

Owner requests, player milestones, and other important
missions appear automatically.
As manager, you must manage player form, restore your
approval rating, and develop young players.

Choose missions carefully on the Mission Selection
screen while checking your Coach Capacity.<+LR>Switch <○>Close 1/6
overrides.0x8208D220:
[Pitcher Role Conversion]
Shift conditioning toward a starter or reliever role in
small steps.

Starters have higher Starter Conditioning.
Relievers have higher Fatigue Recovery.

Balance your staff to keep the rotation running
smoothly.<+LR>Switch <○>Close 5/5
overrides.0x8208D400:
[Position Conversion]
Train a player at a new position so they can cover
multiple positions.

Repeat this training at each year's camp to keep
improving.

However, fielding at the original position will decrease
slightly.

Position changes can transform your team balance. Plan
carefully to build your ideal roster.<+LR>Switch <○>Close 4/5
